subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: Should OpenClaw accept guarded startup deletion of old backup temp artifacts once the timestamped-output coverage bug is fixed?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but the permanent behavior still deletes old partial backup artifacts automatically and needs maintainer acceptance of that operator-facing cleanup policy.

options.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup After Repair
options.body: Land the startup sweep after it covers timestamped outputs and retains tight age, UUID, owner, and output-directory scoping.

options.title: Require Manual/Doctor Cleanup Instead
options.body: Keep backup create non-destructive at startup and move cleanup to an explicit doctor or operator action.

options.title: Pause This PR
options.body: Hold or close this candidate if maintainers do not want old backup temp artifacts deleted automatically.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup After Repair
recommendation.body: Land the startup sweep after it covers timestamped outputs and retains tight age, UUID, owner, and output-directory scoping.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle merged the original backup CLI PR and authored the infra extraction that owns the current backup-create surface.
